title: Chris Ramsay's own associative remote viewing training and results, which led to the Area 52 channel

tellings.quote: um we start getting really crazy results, like good results.

plain: The online video maker Chris Ramsay says that in 2023 he trained in associative remote viewing, a practice in which people try to sense a hidden or future target with the mind alone, and that the group started getting "really crazy results, like good results." He tells Michels this firsthand and credits a man named Brett Stewart. He says these results led him to start a channel called Area 52, and if they were real they would suggest the mind can reach information it has no ordinary way to get.
